description: Save the cook's own version of a recipe they don't own ("make it dairy-free", "halve the sugar", "scale it for 8 and keep that"). Pass only what changes; anything omitted is copied from the original. When you pass ingredients or steps, pass the complete new list (fetch the original with get_recipe first and edit it). Ingredients you keep can be resent without key; they keep the original's tags. For a new ingredient, tag it in the steps by its name in snake_case ({nutritional_yeast}) or set key. Steps carry the amounts, so when you preview a change, show the steps whose amounts change along with the ingredients. Before calling, show the cook the changed ingredients and steps and get a yes; never save silently. Without a title, the version is named after the change ("Dairy-free Chili", "Chili with Olive Oil"). A version made only to change servings keeps those as its default. The version links back to the original, which never changes. Versions are public by default and appear under My versions in the cook's kitchen; visibility "private" keeps it just for the cook (out of search, the sitemap and the original's list of variations). To change it again later, use update_recipe. On a recipe the cook already owns, use update_recipe instead; fork_recipe refuses.

chef_note.description: The chef's note, up to 500 characters: a sentence or two in the cook's words on what makes the recipe theirs. Only what the cook said; never write one for them.

key.description: Short tag steps use, e.g. "flour". When omitted: an ingredient already in the recipe keeps its key (match by item), a new one takes the tag your steps use for it if that tag is its name ("nutritional_yeast") or last word ("yeast"), else the last word of item.

qty.description: Amount, e.g. 1.5 or "1 1/2". Use 0 for 'to taste'.

unit.description: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, qt, oz, lb, g, kg, ml, l, clove, can, slice, sprig, bunch, head, stick, each, or empty

body.description: Step text with amounts as tags: {flour}, a portion {butter:1/2}, oven temp in °F {t:375}

tip.description: A short pointer shown under the step, up to 140 characters: "The batter should look lumpy; don't overmix."

summary.description: One or two sentences on what makes it good

visibility.description: private = just for the cook; public (the default) lists it under the original

name: fork_recipe
title: Save the cook's own version of a recipe
